title: Zeroth-law transitivity, intensive-variable equilibration, and psyche-harmony nonconversion classifier
hypothesis: A typed classifier can preserve thermal-equilibrium transitivity and temperature-measurement conditions while rejecting any inference that interpersonal agreement, emotional harmony, or psychological similarity is a thermodynamic equilibrium relation.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate units, relation domains, contact conditions, transitivity premises, measurement objects, participant labels, and conclusion strength; cross-domain conversion must reject.
evidence_class: bounded structural, proxy, open-gap, or exact-gate software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the frozen software evidence class and cannot promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
